title: Ransomware group claims attack on Missouri’s Cedar County Memorial Hospital after IT outage
content_md: DysruptionHub reports: Cedar County Memorial Hospital in El Dorado Springs, Missouri, shut down its IT networks Aug. 14 after a disruption left its electronic health record, patient portal and internet access unavailable. The outage also disrupted diagnostic imaging.
